status: Root cause addressed with sparse work selection and transient preparation; corrected measurements in fixed/summary.json. The 16-worker benchmark remains on hold.

profile.event: cpu-clock:u at 99 Hz; frame-pointer call stacks
profile.sampling_limit: Short-lived workers may terminate before a sampling period; absence of worker samples does not imply zero worker CPU time.

findings: The compiler applies prepare/parallel-evaluate/replay to all source state keys, although only FStackElement keys perform function discovery.
The native runner creates and joins fresh threads for every batch of at most 256 rows.
The preparation collection retains full GFunction IR; preparation and evaluation results are persisted as part of every round graph.
Generic IR conversion still executes serially before worker specialization.
validation: Corrected implementation: 91 native prelude tests, 8 Wasm tests, 5 incremental compiler tests, 18 integration records. Earlier integration: 1,742 compiler tests.
implemented_changes: Restrict worker batches to pending function rows and keep unchanged state on a direct serial path.
Avoid retaining complete generic IR and redundant row results in persistent intermediate collections.
Worker creation reduced to 1,528; a reusable pool remains future work.
